description:
4th connection. Root cause of the CCSID puzzle FOUND (advisor + this connection's own od -x diagnostic, 3rd connection): the git-cloned file's REAL BYTES were byte-for-byte identical to the seed file's bytes (both genuine EBCDIC, no 0x0A anywhere - git's own '2 insertions' for a multi-hundred-line file was the tell). The bug was never in git or in CRTRPGMOD's CCSID handling - it was that the SEED FILE ITSELF (built by copying a qsh-heredoc-written file, which this harness's own established findings already show is written as real EBCDIC regardless of its CCSID tag) never represented what a real learner's UTF-8/LF git-cloned source actually looks like. advisor: do NOT force a CCSID re-tag (setccsid/TGTCCSID(nnn)) on a file whose true content is fine - that recipe would corrupt a REAL learner's genuinely UTF-8 file if copied into the lesson. FIXED instead by generating a genuine UTF-8/LF seed directly on PUB400 via CPYTOSTMF (STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF), exact parameter shape already used in docs/part03/03-10-outfile-qtemp-ovrdbf.md's own EXPSRC example - that lesson's own CPYTOSTMF usage is itself unconfirmed/未確認, so this connection is its first real test too) from the ALREADY-COMPILED QRPGLESRC/QSRVSRC members this manifest's own file-steps populate, instead of a heredoc-written IFS copy. od -x checkpoints added before AND after every git operation that touches the file's bytes, so a regression is caught immediately rather than guessed at afterward.

Also fixed (advisor, re-reading the 3rd connection's own VFYLOG): JUCSRV was NEVER actually deleted - 'Replaced object JUCSRV type *SRVPGM was moved to QRPLOBJ.' proves an existing object was found and safely replaced. The 1st/2nd connections' CPD0192 'Service program JUCSRV not found' was a *LIBL library-list scoping artifact of the sh-type CLIENTCHECK steps (which never ADDLIBLE'd &LIB, and a separate system() call cannot inherit an ADDLIBLE from an earlier one), not evidence of a real deletion. This connection retargets the SRCSTMF build at the REAL &LIB/JUCSRV directly (the throwaway JUCSRVX detour is no longer needed - DLTMOD/CRTRPGMOD/CRTSRVPGM's own sh-captured output is judged directly, per advisor: if BUILDSRV fails, the OLD object survives untouched, so success is read from BUILDMOD/BUILDSRV's own text, not inferred from CLIENTCHECK). CLIENTCHECK is now two separate cl-type steps (one per client program), each getting its own immediate MONMSG and relying on the wrapper's own auto-ADDLIBLE (confirmed already present in every generated wrapper) instead of a redundant, buggy hand-written ADDLIBLE (CL's MONMSG only guards the single immediately-preceding command, so a shared trailing MONMSG over ADDLIBLE+2 CALLs never actually covered ADDLIBLE's own harmless CPF2103 'already in list' message - this is why the 3rd connection's CLIENTCHECKCL never even reached either CALL).

makei: two connections got the identical (and apparently incorrect - PATH was confirmed correctly set both times) 'not in PATH'/'python3.9 not installed' message from --version/--help. Per advisor, stopped live-probing it entirely; this connection just reads the wrapper script's own source (head -60) as the only obtainable primary source, and moves on.

steps.label: PCREPO
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && mkdir -p pc-side/src/qrpglesrc pc-side/src/qsrvsrc && cd pc-side && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git init -b main 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.name 'Learner (verify harness rehearsal)' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git config user.email 'learner-rehearsal-no-email' 2>&1 && system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QRPGLESRC.FILE/JUCSRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1 && system "CPYTOSTMF FROMMBR('/QSYS.LIB/&LIB.LIB/QSRVSRC.FILE/JUCSRV.MBR') TOSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') STMFOPT(*REPLACE) STMFCCSID(1208) ENDLINFMT(*LF)" 2>&1 && echo ---SEED-CHECK--- && ls -S src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'initial import: JUCSRV source' 2>&1

steps.label: PUSH
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git remote add origin "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-bare.git" 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: CLONE
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal" && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git clone pub400-bare.git pub400-clone 2>&1 && echo ---CLONE-CHECK--- && ls -S pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2

steps.label: BUILDSRV
steps.cmd: system "CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.label: ROUNDTRIP-EDIT
steps.cmd: cd "$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pc-side" && { head -1 src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle; echo '// verify-rehearsal round-trip edit: this comment line only.'; tail -n +2 src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle; } > src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle.tmp && mv src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle.tmp src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle && echo ---EDIT-CHECK--- && ls -S src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 && od -x src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle 2>&1 | head -2 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git add -A 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git commit -m 'round-trip rehearsal: add a comment line' 2>&1 && /QOpenSys/pkgs/bin/git --no-pager push origin main 2>&1

steps.label: ROUNDTRIP-REBUILD
steps.cmd:
system "DLTMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV)" 2>&1
system "CRTRPGMOD MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qrpglesrc/jucsrv.rpgle') TGTCCSID(*JOB) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1
system "CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/JUCSRV) MODULE(&LIB/JUCSRV) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCSTMF('$HOME/vfy/part08-01-git-srcstmf/rehearsal/pub400-clone/src/qsrvsrc/jucsrv.bnd') ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)" 2>&1

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME = 'JUCSRV' ORDER BY OBJTYPE

SELECT PROGRAM_NAME, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_LIBRARY, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM, BOUND_SERVICE_PROGRAM_ACTIVATION FROM QSYS2.BOUND_SRVPGM_INFO WHERE PROGRAM_LIBRARY = '&LIB' AND PROGRAM_NAME IN ('F0702A', 'F0703A') ORDER BY PROGRAM_NAME
